description: Selection positive control: the request plainly needs a skill the arm placed in the host's discovery location (ledgerline-import, an invented format nothing else teaches). Passes when the run loads that skill; format_ok corroborates the detection, and target_listed and target_described show whether the listing the host sent the model named the skill and showed its description (Codex and Claude only).
